objective: Show NPC dialogue lines in the dialogue panel.
criteria: every dialogue line is shown whole in vi and en at 1280x720
context: Vietnamese lines run 30-60% longer than English. The panel is 900x120 px at 1280x720.
diff:
--- a/src/presentation/dialogue/dialogue_panel.gd
+++ b/src/presentation/dialogue/dialogue_panel.gd
@@ -10,6 +10,10 @@ func show_line(text_key: StringName) -> void:
+	_line_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
+	_line_label.clip_text = true
+	_line_label.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+	_line_label.text = tr(text_key)
